developmentCounterexample.cause: The v0.1 acceptance language conflated the evaluated closest-approach sample used to place the support-surface anchor with the earlier solver contact onset, and measured spring settling from the authored object origin instead of the evaluated precontact Bullet equilibrium.

correctedMeasurementSemantics.anchorFrame: closest evaluated effector-to-support sample with inward normal velocity inside the frozen search window
correctedMeasurementSemantics.contactFrame: first Bullet-evaluated mechanism displacement at least 0.0005 m from the precontact equilibrium
correctedMeasurementSemantics.precontactEquilibrium: median Bullet-evaluated plunger axis coordinate across eight consecutive frames ending at least sixteen frames before the anchor frame
correctedMeasurementSemantics.plungerDisplacement: absolute signed-axis delta from that precontact equilibrium
correctedMeasurementSemantics.settledResidual: absolute signed-axis delta from the same precontact equilibrium
correctedMeasurementSemantics.firstResponseDelay: first response frame minus solver-derived contact frame
correctedMeasurementSemantics.motionBlurMeasurementFrame: impact presentation frame selected from the Bullet response, not a manual frame

claimCeiling: This correction defines honest solver-relative measurements; it does not claim the revised development run or formal RC1 result passes.
